fact: From 29 June to 10 July 2026 delegates from Guinea-Bissau and four other countries evaluated proposals for submarine cable capacity for a second submarine cable under WARDIP, to add redundancy.
title: COMISSÃO DA CEDEAO ORGANIZA REUNIÃO DO COMITÊ DE AVALIAÇÃO SOBRE A CAPACIDADE DE CABO SUBMARINO NA ÁFRICA OCIDENTAL NO ÂMBITO DO WARDIP
